storyCards.fact:
Mika's "Love Today" reached #92 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Love Today" is the second single released by London-based singer Mika, taken from his debut studio album, Life in Cartoon Motion (2007).

The song peaked at #92 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 1 weeks on the chart.

Love Today was released in 2007.
